newsitem.title: PANAMA: Former Panama central bank officials jailed.
newsitem.headline: Former Panama central bank officials jailed.

text.p: Two aides of former strongman Manuel Antonio Noriega who ran Panama's central bank were jailed on Monday for embezzling millions of dollars from the state, a court spokeswoman said on Tuesday.

Fourth Circuit Court Judge Yanela Romero de Pimentel sentenced Rafael Arosemena, former director of Panama's central bank, to eight years for embezzling nearly $1 million for the ruling party during Noriega's rule, the spokeswoman said. Arosemana remains exiled in Mexico after fleeing there one year after Noriega was ousted by U.S. forces in 1989.
Former central bank comptroller Constantino Peralta, who has been held in Panama City's Modelo Prison, was sentenced to six years for his role in the crimes, according to court documents.
